newsitem.title: UK: Vision Group gains on results, cash call.
newsitem.headline: Vision Group gains on results, cash call.

text.p: Shares of Vision Group Plc, a maker of electronic cameras, gained on Tuesday after the company announced a rights issue to raise 11.5 million stg to fund expansion and said its growth "continues to accelerate."
The shares had risen 13-1/2p to 279-1/2p by 1003 GMT, albeit in thin trading volume of 2,500.

"Our growth continues to accelerate," said managing director Peter Denyer, "and we are particularly pleased to be able to report a profit for the first quarter of the year just started on sales which outstripped the whole of last year."
The company said three major additional contracts had recently been signed which it believes "will drive production and sales to wholly new levels from the middle of 1997 onwards."

The new contracts were for colour products in the toy, digital stills and desktop videoconferencing markets. Proceeds of the cash call would allow it to step up manufacturing capability and meet working capital requirements, it said.

Vision Group said turnover in the year ended July 31 rose to 4.42 million stg from 1.73 million stg in the same period last year. It posted a profit before tax for the three months ending October 31 of 68,114 stg.
Turnover in the three months ended Oct 31 of 4.57 million stg exceeded the company's sales of 4.42 million stg in the whole of last year.
The company proposed a rights issue of up to 5.1 million new ordinary shares at 235p per share, on the basis of three new ordinary shares for every 19 already held.
